lessons.primaryPurpose: Introduce epistemic probability markers distinguishing: 1) Sensory evidential inference based on visible/tangible evidence (бололтой / шинжтэй 'it appears that, seemingly'), and 2) Abstract hypothetical possibility (магадгүй / байж мэднэ 'perhaps, possibly, maybe').
lessons.communicativeOutcome: Express carefully calibrated speculation differentiating what is inferred from visual signs versus what is hypothetical.
lessons.audioPurpose: Model subtle rising terminal tone indicating uncertainty and evidential deduction.
